name: Tsugihana Misumi
source: A popular girl with an outstanding appearance and excellent grades in all of her studies. She was the winner of the previous Miss Aoanafune Academy, but apparently her older sister applied her to it without telling her. Despite being quite serious at times, Misumi is overall a kind girl at heart who just has problems smiling.
